---
title: "About Me"
---

I am a student at the Mathematical Sciences program, [Universiti Brunei Darussalam](https://ubd.edu.bn/). I reside permanently in Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, and am currently temporarily staying in Brunei. My current research project focuses on spatial modeling for Gaussian data, where I utilize Bayesian hierarchical models and conditional autoregressive (CAR) models to elucidate the spatial structure within neighborhood areas. Additionally, I am actively learning R to support and enhance my research endeavors.
